text: Before the world feared Doctor Doom, there was Victor von Doom.
Born in Latveria, Victor's life was shaped by tragedy, and by the loss of those he loved.
His intellect mastered science. His ambition reached into forbidden magic.
Trying to reach his dead mother, Victor pushed his experiment beyond the limits of what he understood.
The accident scarred his face. But the deeper wound was his refusal to accept imperfection.
He forged a mask, buried his vulnerability, and chose the identity the world would come to fear.
He was not content to be extraordinary. He had to be infallible. And that became his greatest weakness.
